sections.title: Composition
beats: Multiplying two matrices = doing one move, then the other.
Read right to left: in AB, B happens first.
sections.example: Putting on socks then shoes is not the same as shoes then socks.
sections.sayback: Explain why AB ≠ BA in general.

quiz.q: In ABv, which acts on v first?

sections.title: Computing it
beats: Column 1 of AB = A times column 1 of B. Same for column 2.
sections.example: A 2-layer network without activations collapses into one matrix. That's why activations matter.

quiz.q: Why do deep nets need nonlinear activations?
quiz.a: Without them, stacked layers multiply into one single matrix.
